experiment_data.hypothesis: SFT baseline: supervised finetuning on FOLIO data (500 steps, Qwen3-4B) to establish whether hacking patterns are GRPO-specific or general finetuning artifacts. Same model as all GRPO experiments for fair comparison.
experiment_data.notes: 模型必须改为 Qwen3-4B（与 GRPO 实验一致）。用 Qwen2.5-1.5B 无法作为 fair baseline——模型不同无法隔离训练方法差异。修正模型后重新注册提交。
